title: Five Years Later
content:
Five years passed.

Five years...

Since Siddu had left India with a heart full of unanswered emotions.

Time never stopped.

It quietly carried both of them forward.

Siddu devoted himself entirely to his new life in France.

Days turned into months.

Months turned into years.

His dedication, hard work, and talent earned him one promotion after another. Before long, he had become one of the most respected and well-known professionals in France, admired by colleagues and recognized throughout his industry.

Yet...

Despite all his success...

There were some memories that time could never erase.

________________________________________

Back in India...

Life had changed for Sneha as well.

She had become successful in her career and was now staying in a company-provided hotel while working on an important project.

One peaceful morning, she got ready for work and sat down in the cafeteria for breakfast.

Just as she was about to take her first bite, her phone began to ring.

Mom Calling...

A small smile appeared on her face as she answered.

"Good morning, Mom."

"Good morning, Sneha," her mother replied warmly.

"Have you had your breakfast?"

Sneha smiled.

"Not yet."

"I was just about to start."

Her mother immediately said,

"Then stop eating for a moment and come to the cafeteria entrance."

Sneha frowned.

"Why, Mom?"

There was a brief silence.

Then her mother spoke with excitement.

"Someone has come to meet you."

"He wants to spend his life with you."

Sneha instantly understood what she meant.

Her smile disappeared.

"Mom..."

"I've already told you to stop looking for matches."

"Why don't you listen to me?"

Her mother's voice became softer.

"Sneha..."

"You're twenty-seven now."

"As your mother..."

"How long can I keep watching you live alone?"

"I only want to see you happy."

Sneha closed her eyes.

She had no answer.

Without saying another word...

She quietly ended the call.

For a few moments, she simply stared at the untouched breakfast in front of her.

Then she stood up and left for the office.

________________________________________

The moment she entered, she buried herself in work.

She hoped it would distract her.

But her thoughts remained unsettled.

Just then...

Someone gently tapped her shoulder.

She turned around.

"Yagnesh..."

He looked at her carefully.

"What happened?"

"You look upset."

Sneha sighed.

"Mom started talking about marriage again."

Yagnesh remained silent for a moment.

Then he spoke gently.

"Sneha..."

"How long are you going to keep waiting for Siddu?"

"It's been five years."

"He left for France."

"And as things stand..."

"Our company doesn't even have a partnership there."

"There isn't even a chance for you to get transferred."

He hesitated before asking another question.

"And..."

"What if..."

"What if Siddu has already moved on?"

"What if he's with someone else now?"

The words hit Sneha like a storm.

She immediately looked at him.

"No."

"He wouldn't do that."

Yagnesh looked at her quietly.

"How can you be so sure?"

Sneha smiled faintly.

"Because I know him."

"He loves me."

"He just didn't have the courage to accept it."

"He wasn't afraid of love..."

"He was afraid of becoming the reason for my pain."

Yagnesh wanted to say something more.

But one look at her eyes told him she had already made up her mind years ago.

Nothing he said would change it.

Sneha slowly stood up.

"Yagnesh..."

"I'm taking leave for the rest of the day."

"Please inform Rohini ma'am."

He nodded.

"Alright."

Without another word...

Sneha quietly walked out of the office.

Yagnesh watched her leave.

For the first time...

He wondered whether waiting for someone across countries...

Was an act of hope...

Or an act of heartbreak.
